decisions.choice: all these things: the events of 13:5-23, including the fall of the temple
alternatives: everything in the speech, including the coming of the Son of Man
decisions.reason: "These things" in 13:29 are the signs that come before the end. Read that way, Jesus says his own generation will see them, while the day itself no one knows (13:32).

decisions.choice: will not: a double negative, a firm promise
decisions.reason: The strongest form of denial.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as elsewhere in Mark.

decisions.choice: the people now living
decisions.reason: Readable follows the reading chosen above. If it is wrong, this wording says more than the Greek.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R)
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese John's form for "Truly, truly", with the single word Mark has. Recorded once for the chapter.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R), through Mark 13-14
decisions.reason: As at Mark 3:28, the single form of the Korean John's "진실로 진실로"; modern endings replace the archaic "이르노니".

source.text: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται.

records.literal_gloss: The heaven and the earth will pass away, but the words of me no not will pass away.

en.L: Heaven and earth will pass away, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will by no means pass away.
en.B: Heaven and earth will pass away, yet {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will never pass away.
en.R: The sky and the earth will come to an end, but {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words will last forever.

vi.L: Trời và đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ không qua đi.
vi.B: Trời đất sẽ qua đi, nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ qua đi.
vi.R: Trời và đất sẽ không còn nữa, nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 하늘과 땅은 지나갈 것이다. 그러나 내 말들은 결코 지나가지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 하늘과 땅은 사라지겠지만, 내 말은 절대로 사라지지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅은 언젠가 끝날 것이다. 그러나 내 말은 영원히 남을 것이다.

decisions.choice: heaven and earth pass, my words remain: as God's word stands forever
decisions.reason: Isaiah 40:8 says the word of our God stands forever, and Isaiah 51:6 says the heavens will vanish like smoke. Jesus says of his own words what the prophets said of God's word.

decisions.choice: will by no means pass away: a double negative
decisions.reason: The strongest denial: his words will never fail.

decisions.choice: come to an end; last forever
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for passing away and never passing away.

decisions.choice: "지나가다" (L), as in 13:30
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same verb for the generation in 13:30 and for heaven and earth here; Literal keeps one Korean verb for both.

source.text: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ.

records.literal_gloss: Concerning now the day that or the hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven nor the Son, except the Father.

en.L: But concerning that day or the hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, except the Father.
en.B: As for that day or hour, nobody knows it, neither the angels in heaven nor the Son. Only the Father knows.
en.R: But no one knows the day or the hour when this will happen. The angels in heaven do not know. Even the Son does not know. Only the Father knows.

vi.L: Nhưng về ngày đó hoặc giờ đó thì không ai biết, ngay cả các thiên sứ trên trời, ngay cả Con cũng không, chỉ có Cha [biết] mà thôi.
vi.B: Còn về ngày ấy hay giờ ấy thì không ai biết, kể cả các thiên sứ trên trời hay Con cũng không biết. Chỉ một mình Cha biết mà thôi.
vi.R: Nhưng không ai biết ngày nào hay giờ nào việc này sẽ xảy ra. Các thiên sứ trên trời không biết. Ngay cả Con cũng không biết. Chỉ có Cha biết mà thôi.

ko.L: 그러나 그 날이나 그 때에 대해서는 아무도 모른다. 하늘에 있는 천사들도 모르고, 아들도 모르고, 오직 아버지만 아신다.
ko.B: 그 날이나 그 때는 아무도 모른다. 하늘의 천사들도 모르고 아들도 모른다. 오직 아버지께서만 아신다.
ko.R: 그러나 이 일이 일어날 날과 때는 아무도 모른다. 하늘에 있는 천사들도 모른다. 아들조차도 모른다. 오직 아버지께서만 아신다.

decisions.choice: that day: the day of the Son of Man's coming (13:26)
alternatives: the day of the temple's fall
decisions.reason: "That day" is the prophets' phrase for the day of the Lord. Here it is the day of the coming just described.

decisions.choice: nor the Son: Jesus says that he, the Son, does not know the day
alternatives: the Son knows but will not tell
decisions.reason: Mark records this plainly. The Son shares the life of the Father, yet as he lives among people he does not know the day; the Father alone has set it. The text does not explain this further.

decisions.choice: the Son, the Father: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son of God the Father
decisions.reason: Only here in Mark does Jesus call himself simply "the Son" beside "the Father".

decisions.choice: when this will happen; Even the Son does not know
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the list into short sentences and says what the day is.

decisions.choice: "Con" and "Cha", capitalised, with no setting
decisions.reason: As in John, "Con" and "Cha" are nouns for the Son and the Father, always capitalised; the style guide gives them no setting span.

decisions.choice: "아들도 모른다" with no honorific; "아버지께서만 아신다" with it
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son, so he does not honour himself, as with "인자"; he honours the Father.

source.text: βλέπετε ἀγρυπνεῖτε, οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός ἐστιν·

records.literal_gloss: Take heed, keep awake; not you know for when the time is.

en.L: Take care, stay awake; for you do not know when the time is.
en.B: Be on your guard and stay alert, because you do not know when the time will come.
en.R: So be careful! Stay awake! You do not know when that time will come.

vi.L: Hãy coi chừng, hãy tỉnh táo; vì các con không biết khi nào là thời điểm ấy.
vi.B: Hãy đề phòng và tỉnh táo, vì các con không biết khi nào thời điểm ấy sẽ đến.
vi.R: Vậy hãy cẩn thận! Hãy tỉnh táo! Các con không biết khi nào thời điểm ấy sẽ đến.

ko.L: 주의하여라, 깨어 있어라. 그 시기가 언제인지 너희가 알지 못하기 때문이다.
ko.B: 조심하고 깨어 있어라. 그 때가 언제 올지 너희는 모른다.
ko.R: 그러니 조심하여라! 잠들지 말고 깨어 있어라! 그 때가 언제 올지 너희는 모른다.

decisions.choice: keep awake: stay alert, do not fall asleep
decisions.reason: The verb means to be sleepless. It means watching and being ready.

decisions.choice: the time: the appointed time, the moment God has set
decisions.reason: This word for time often means a fixed or decisive moment.

decisions.choice: stay awake: the SBLGNT reading
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "and pray", perhaps from 14:38. Some important early manuscripts lack it. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: stay alert
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a word that covers both keeping awake and being ready.

decisions.choice: "깨어 있어라" for agrypneo and gregoreo (13:33-37), every level
decisions.reason: Jesus' repeated call to stay awake ties this speech to Gethsemane (14:34-38); one phrase keeps that link. Readable adds "잠들지 말고" to say what it means.

decisions.choice: "그 시기" (L) for kairos
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "때" for hora (13:11, 32) and uses "시기" for kairos, so the two Greek words stay apart; Balanced and Readable say "그 때".

source.text: ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀπόδημος ἀφεὶς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ δοὺς τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐξουσίαν, ἑκάστῳ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τῷ θυρωρῷ ἐνετείλατο ἵνα γρηγορῇ.

records.literal_gloss: Like a man away from home, having left the house of him and having given to the slaves of him the authority, to each the work of him, and the doorkeeper he commanded that he keep watch.

en.L: [It is] like a man away on a journey, who left his house and gave his slaves the authority, to each one {{gender:their|his}} work, and commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
en.B: It is like a man who goes away from home. He leaves his house, puts his servants in charge, each with a task to do, and orders the doorkeeper to keep watch.
en.R: It is like a man who goes on a trip. He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge of it. He gives each one a job to do. He tells the one who guards the door to stay awake and keep watch.

vi.L: [Điều ấy] giống như một người đi xa, rời nhà mình và giao quyền cho các nô lệ mình, mỗi người một việc, và truyền cho người gác cửa phải thức canh.
vi.B: Việc ấy giống như một người đi xa nhà. Ông rời nhà, giao cho các đầy tớ trông coi, mỗi người một việc, và dặn người gác cửa phải thức canh.
vi.R: Việc ấy giống như một người đi xa. Ông rời nhà và giao cho các đầy tớ trông coi nhà. Ông giao cho mỗi người một việc. Ông dặn người gác cửa phải thức và canh chừng.

ko.L: [그것은] 마치 집을 떠나 여행하는 어떤 사람이 자기 집을 떠나면서 자기 종들에게 권한을, 각자에게 자기 일을 주고, 문지기에게는 깨어 있으라고 명령한 것과 같다.
ko.B: 그것은 마치 집을 떠나 먼 길을 가는 사람과 같다. 그는 집을 떠나면서 종들에게 집안일을 맡기고, 각 사람에게 할 일을 정해 주고, 문지기에게는 깨어 지키라고 명령한다.
ko.R: 그것은 여행을 떠나는 어떤 사람과 같다. 그는 집을 떠나면서 종들에게 집을 맡긴다. 그리고 한 사람 한 사람에게 할 일을 준다. 문을 지키는 종에게는 잠들지 말고 잘 지키라고 이른다.

decisions.choice: slaves: household slaves who ran the house for their owner
decisions.reason: The word means slaves, people owned by their master. In a large household some were trusted with the running of the house.

decisions.choice: the authority: charge of the house while the owner was away
alternatives: power over the other slaves only
decisions.reason: He hands over the running of his house, with work for each one.

decisions.choice: the doorkeeper: the slave who guarded the door and let people in
decisions.reason: His task is to stay awake and open when the owner returns.

decisions.choice: like: a comparison with no main verb
decisions.reason: The sentence begins a comparison and leaves it unfinished. Its point is drawn in the command that follows (13:35).

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that they were owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: He leaves ... puts ... orders (present tense)
decisions.reason: Balanced tells the comparison in the present, as one tells an example.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's rendering of doulos, as in John: the hard word at Literal, the household servant at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "thức canh" for "keep watch", here, in 13:35-37 and in Gethsemane (14:34-38)
decisions.reason: "Thức canh" joins staying awake and keeping guard, the two senses of the verb, and lets the same word return when the disciples fall asleep in Gethsemane, as the meaning decision on 13:35 points out.

decisions.choice: "종" for doulos, every level
decisions.reason: The Korean style guide uses "종" at every level; it already names someone owned by a master, so Korean needs no change of word between Literal and Balanced. The English decision on "slave" and "servant" applies to the English only.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "각자에게 자기 일을" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" is not gendered, so the English span has nothing to change.

source.text: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἔρχεται, ἢ ὀψὲ ἢ μεσονύκτιον ἢ ἀλεκτοροφωνίας ἢ πρωΐ, μὴ ἐλθὼν ἐξαίφνης εὕρῃ ὑμᾶς καθεύδοντας·

records.literal_gloss: Watch therefore, not you know for when the lord of the house comes, either at evening or at midnight or at rooster-crowing or early, \v 36 lest having come suddenly he find you sleeping.

en.L: Keep watch therefore, for you do not know when the lord of the house is coming, whether in the evening, or at midnight, or at rooster-crow, or early in the morning, \v 36 lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
en.B: So keep watch, since you cannot know when the master of the house is coming: in the evening, at midnight, at the crowing of the rooster, or at dawn. \v 36 Otherwise he may arrive suddenly and find you asleep.
en.R: So stay awake! You do not know when the owner of the house will come back. It might be in the evening or at midnight. It might be when the rooster crows in the dark, or early in the morning. \v 36 If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.

vi.L: Vậy hãy thức canh, vì các con không biết khi nào chủ nhà đến, hoặc lúc chiều tối, hoặc lúc nửa đêm, hoặc lúc gà gáy, hoặc lúc sáng sớm; \v 36 kẻo khi [ông ấy] đến thình lình, thấy các con đang ngủ.
vi.B: Vậy hãy thức canh, vì các con không thể biết khi nào chủ nhà sẽ về: lúc chiều tối, lúc nửa đêm, lúc gà gáy, hay lúc rạng đông. \v 36 Kẻo ông ấy về bất ngờ mà thấy các con đang ngủ.
vi.R: Vậy hãy thức canh! Các con không biết khi nào người chủ nhà sẽ trở về. Có thể là lúc chiều tối hay lúc nửa đêm. Có thể là lúc gà gáy khi trời còn tối, hay lúc sáng sớm. \v 36 Nếu ông ấy về bất ngờ, đừng để ông thấy các con đang ngủ.

ko.L: 그러므로 깨어 있어라. 집의 주인이 언제 올지, 저녁일지, 한밤중일지, 닭 울 때일지, 새벽일지, 너희가 알지 못하기 때문이다. \v 36 그가 갑자기 와서 너희가 자고 있는 것을 보지 않도록 하여라.
ko.B: 그러므로 깨어 있어라. 집주인이 언제 돌아올지 너희는 모른다. 저녁일지, 한밤중일지, 닭이 울 무렵일지, 이른 아침일지 모른다. \v 36 그가 갑자기 돌아와서 너희가 자고 있는 것을 보게 해서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 그러니 잠들지 말고 깨어 있어라! 집주인이 언제 돌아올지 너희는 모른다. 저녁일 수도 있고 한밤중일 수도 있다. 어두운 새벽에 닭이 울 때일 수도 있고, 이른 아침일 수도 있다. \v 36 주인이 갑자기 돌아왔을 때, 너희가 자고 있는 모습을 보이지 마라.

decisions.choice: evening, midnight, rooster-crow, early morning: the four watches of the night
decisions.reason: The Romans divided the night into four watches of about three hours each, from about six in the evening to six in the morning. The owner may come in any of them.

decisions.choice: the lord of the house: the master and owner
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "Lord". In the comparison he is the owner, and he stands for Jesus, whose return the disciples must wait for.

decisions.choice: the four watches: the same times come in the story of Jesus' last night
decisions.reason: Evening (14:17), the disciples sleeping in the night (14:37-41), the rooster crowing (14:72), and early morning (15:1). Mark may intend his readers to notice.

decisions.choice: lest he find you sleeping: the reason to keep watch
decisions.reason: The danger is being found asleep when the master comes.

decisions.choice: lord (L); master (B); owner (R)
decisions.reason: In the comparison the word is lowercase, since it names the owner of the house. Literal keeps the word that can also mean Lord.

decisions.choice: "chủ nhà" at every level
decisions.reason: The English needs three words (lord, master, owner); the one Vietnamese word "chủ" covers all of them in plain language. The master is a figure in a comparison, so "ông ấy" takes no setting.

decisions.choice: "집의 주인" (L); "집주인" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean "주인" covers lord, master and owner, so one word serves every level; "주" or "주님" would sound like a title of God or Jesus.

records.literal_gloss: What now to you I say, to all I say, keep watch.

en.L: And what I say to you, I say to all: keep watch."
en.B: What I tell you, I tell everyone: Keep watch!"
en.R: What I am telling you, I am telling everyone: Stay awake!"

vi.B: Điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng nói với mọi người: Hãy thức canh!"
vi.R: Điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng nói với mọi người: Hãy thức canh!"

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희에게 말하는 것을 모든 사람에게 말한다. 깨어 있어라."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 하는 말은 모든 사람에게 하는 말이다. 깨어 있어라!"
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 하는 이 말은 모든 사람에게 하는 말이다. 잠들지 말고 깨어 있어라!"

decisions.choice: all: everyone, not just the four
decisions.reason: The speech was given to four disciples (13:3), but the warning is for all who follow Jesus.

decisions.choice: keep watch: a present command, keep on watching
decisions.reason: The speech ends with the same command as 13:35: stay watchful.

decisions.choice: tell (B); am telling (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use "tell" for this kind of saying.
